challenges

What we needed to solve

01

Release the app to the stores

Deadline: 3 months

02

Decrease delivery time

Through changing the design system and processes

process

My first steps

  • Set up regular design handoff sessions with developers
  • Aligned Figma navigation and page naming with the codebase structure
  • Together with the developers, defined a strategy for handling legacy
  • Together with the McKinsey team, defined the prioritization of product tasks
process

Tokens & typography

  • Reused colour token schemes from Web
  • Created numeric tokens for sizes
  • Cleaned up typography
  • Set up modes: dark and light, iOS and Android — fonts and screen sizes
process

Components

  • Removed components with duplicate functionality
  • Rebuilt the legacy ones
  • Created new ones that were missing
process

A framework for flowcharts

I proposed not duplicating mockups, but placing a block with a link to them instead — so there would be fewer mockups to keep up to date, without losing information.

My goal was to reduce the number of mockups so they'd be easier to keep up to date, without losing information

process

Legacy and new flows

We rebuilt the legacy flows and created the new ones.
